editorial: Get ready for a wild ride that will keep you guessing until the very last second. You follow a marshal on a creepy island trying to find a missing patient, but nothing is what it seems. Leonardo DiCaprio gives an amazing performance that makes you feel his confusion and fear. You will love this if you enjoy mysteries that make your head spin.
endingExplained: Teddy is actually a patient at the hospital, not a marshal. The doctors played a giant game to help him face the truth about his past. He chooses to pretend he is still sick so he can be treated rather than live with his guilt.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves a giant plot twist.
